basic_profile.bio: Avid fan of speculative fiction and horror, TimeTraveler99 hails from the picturesque town of Asheville, North Carolina. Delighting in the macabre and the mysterious, they spend their time writing short horror stories and exploring the quirks of human nature through literature. By day, they work as a freelance graphic designer, a job that offers the flexibility to engage in their passion for music, especially the ukulele. A regular at local open mics, they enjoy blending humor with chilling tales. Single and content, they often delve into Reddit during late-night hours, when inspiration strikes.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: TimeTraveler99 possesses a well-rounded knowledge base acquired through a degree in English Literature and years of self-directed learning. Their expertise in horror and dark fantasy is complemented by a deep understanding of graphic design principles, honed through both academic pursuits and practical experience in the freelance market.
